description: API Authentication Endpoint & Auto-Generated OpenAPI Spec - Add stateless token-only auth for external developers and migrate to @hono/zod-openapi for auto-generated API documentation

userStories.title: Install @hono/zod-openapi and create shared API schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need @hono/zod-openapi installed and shared Zod schemas created so all API routes can be defined with OpenAPI metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Add @hono/zod-openapi as a devDependency in packages/core/package.json

Create src/schemas/api-schemas.ts with reusable Zod schemas: ErrorResponse ({ error: string, details?: string[] }), TokenResponse ({ token: string, expires_in: number, token_type: 'Bearer' }), UserResponse ({ id, email, username, firstName, lastName, role }), ContentItem ({ id, title, slug, collectionId, data, created_at, updated_at })
Export all schemas from src/schemas/api-schemas.ts
Run npm install successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Installed @hono/zod-openapi@1.2.2 (supports Zod v4). Created api-schemas.ts with ErrorResponse, TokenResponse, UserResponse, ContentItem schemas.

userStories.title: Create OpenAPI base app factory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an OpenAPI-enabled Hono app factory so routes defined with createRoute() automatically contribute to the generated spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/openapi-app.ts that exports a function to create an OpenAPIHono app instance
Configure OpenAPI registry with base info: title 'WarpCMS API', version '0.1.0', contact, license (reuse existing values from api.ts)
Register bearerAuth security scheme (type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT)
Register tags: System, Content, Media, Auth
Export the factory function for use by route files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created openapi-app.ts with createOpenAPIApp() factory, bearerAuth security scheme, openAPIDocInfo metadata, and openAPITags (Auth, Content, Media, System).

userStories.title: Create POST /api/auth/token endpoint
userStories.description: As an external developer, I want to POST credentials to /api/auth/token and receive only a JWT token as JSON, so I can authenticate API requests without cookies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api-auth.ts with a new OpenAPIHono router
POST /api/auth/token accepts { email: string, password: string } as JSON body validated with Zod
On success returns { token: string, expires_in: 86400, token_type: 'Bearer' } with status 200
On invalid credentials returns { error: 'Invalid email or password' } with status 401
On validation failure returns { error: string, details: [...] } with status 400
Does NOT set any cookies
Does NOT update last_login_at
Route defined with createRoute() and registered with @hono/zod-openapi
CORS middleware applied (same as other /api/* routes)
Reuses existing AuthManager.verifyPassword and AuthManager.generateToken
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created api-auth.ts with OpenAPIHono router. POST /token validates email+password via Zod, queries D1, verifies with AuthManager.verifyPassword, returns JWT via AuthManager.generateToken. No cookies set, no last_login_at update. CORS applied. Route defined with createRoute().

userStories.title: Create GET /api/auth/me endpoint
userStories.description: As an external developer, I want to verify my token and get my user info via the API.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/auth/me requires Authorization: Bearer <token> header
On success returns { user: { id, email, username, firstName, lastName, role } } with status 200
On missing/invalid token returns { error: string } with status 401
Uses existing requireAuth() middleware
Route defined with createRoute() and registered with @hono/zod-openapi
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added GET /me endpoint to api-auth.ts. Uses requireAuth() middleware for token validation. Queries DB for full user profile (JWT only has userId/email/role). Maps snake_case DB fields to camelCase response. Returns { user: { id, email, username, firstName, lastName, role } }.

userStories.title: Create POST /api/auth/refresh endpoint
userStories.description: As an external developer, I want to refresh my token before it expires to maintain long-running integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/refresh requires Authorization: Bearer <token> header
On success returns { token: string, expires_in: 86400, token_type: 'Bearer' } with status 200
On missing/invalid token returns { error: string } with status 401
Does NOT set any cookies
Uses existing requireAuth() middleware and AuthManager.generateToken
Route defined with createRoute() and registered with @hono/zod-openapi
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added POST /refresh endpoint to api-auth.ts. Uses requireAuth() middleware for token validation. Generates new JWT from existing payload (userId, email, role). Returns { token, expires_in: 86400, token_type: 'Bearer' }. No cookies set. No DB query needed — JWT payload has all required fields.

userStories.title: Mount /api/auth routes in app.ts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the new API auth routes mounted in the main app so they are accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: Import apiAuthRoutes from src/routes/api-auth.ts in app.ts
Mount with app.route('/api/auth', apiAuthRoutes)
Export apiAuthRoutes from src/routes/index.ts
CORS middleware applied to /api/auth/* routes
Existing /auth/* routes remain unchanged and functional
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Exported apiAuthRoutes from routes/index.ts. Imported in app.ts and mounted with app.route('/api/auth', apiAuthRoutes). CORS already applied in api-auth.ts. Existing /auth/* routes unchanged.

userStories.title: Migrate /api/content list and create routes to zod-openapi
userStories.description: As a developer, I need GET /api/content and POST /api/content defined as OpenAPI routes with schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/content defined with createRoute() including query param schemas (collection: string, limit: integer, offset: integer)
POST /api/content defined with createRoute() including request body schema (collection_id, title, slug, data) and bearerAuth security
All existing behavior preserved — no functional changes to handlers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass (npx vitest --run)
userStories.notes: Migrated GET /api/content and POST /api/content to zod-openapi. api.ts converted from Hono to OpenAPIHono. GET /content defined with createRoute() including ContentListQuerySchema (collection, limit, offset). api-content-crud.ts converted to OpenAPIHono with bearerAuth. POST / defined with createRoute() and CreateContentBodySchema (collectionId, title, slug, data). Added ServerErrorSchema to api-schemas.ts for 500 responses. All handlers preserve existing behavior.
